name: search-engines-disabled-offers-nothing
description: Search engines plan: a starter turned off in settings mirrors to TemplateURLService as absent, so its keyword offers nothing. This is the negative case for search-engines-tab-to-youtube.json: same flow, but the settings fixture ships YouTube with enabled: false, so typing the exact same keyword must produce no row and Tab must open no scope. Without this, a mirror that ignored the enabled flag entirely would still pass the positive scenario.

actions.note: GATE: the restored tab has committed, so the app is up and the profile is live
the reserved chrome context lands about 670ms after startup and the palette's WebContents needs it
ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot
let the /commandbar document commit and take the field
the keyword pass has to finish before any row could carry an engine
the disabled engine's keyword resolves to no TemplateURL, so no row carries it
Tab has no scope to enter
THE MEASUREMENT: Tab opened no scope, because the mirror never gave TemplateURLService a disabled engine's keyword

assertions.desc: the disabled starter offers no Tab-to-search row
and Tab entered no scope, since there was nothing to enter
